enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow under head. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to right side. Bend left arm under pillow. Straighten legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Remain still. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still.

Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and vegetables. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil to pan. Add eggs and vegetables. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Use computer to update records. Talk to patient. Measure blood pressure. Administer medication. Walk to patient room. Adjust IV drip. Talk to doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Update patient files. End shift. Change out of scrubs. Walk out of building.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil to pot. Add vegetables and meat. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Change channels. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Type password. Open web browser. Navigate to website. Scroll through content. Click on video. Watch video. Adjust volume. Open game. Play game. Use keyboard and mouse. Close game. Check emails. Shut down computer. Close laptop lid. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Remove clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Put on pajamas. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down. Pull blanket.
Sit up on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Place remote on nightstand. Lie down. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Turn to left side. Remain still. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Remain still.
